newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine holding firm maps out investments.
newsitem.headline: Philippine holding firm maps out investments.

text.p: Holding concern Global Equities Inc is acquiring a 40 percent equity stake in Daklin, a leading supplier of novelty electronic products in the U.S. and Europe.

In documents submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company also disclosed its acquisition of Adamson & Adamson Inc (AAI), a leading local manufacturer of personal and baby care consumer products.
Global plans to spin-off AAI and have it listed on the exchange in the long term.
Global also said it is firming up property acquisitions for its proposed 37-hectare light industrial park in the Manila district of Paranaque.
